meta_description: The Jungle Book story and moral, Kipling's original tale, and read-aloud tips that teach children friendship and courage. A guide to this adventure classic for ages 5–7.

content.alt: The Jungle Book - What kind of story is The Jungle Book?
content.text:
What kind of story is The Jungle Book?

The Jungle Book is an adventure classic about Mowgli, a boy raised by a wolf pack, who grows up in the jungle alongside Baloo the bear and Bagheera the black panther. It joyfully shares friendship in nature, courage, and the wisdom of living together.

content.alt: The Jungle Book - The original Jungle Book story
content.text:
The original Jungle Book story

The original is "The Jungle Book," a collection of short stories published in 1894 by the British author Rudyard Kipling. At its heart are charming animal characters — Mowgli, Baloo the bear, Bagheera the black panther, and Shere Khan the tiger — and the "Law of the Jungle."

content.alt: The Jungle Book - A summary of the Jungle Book story
content.text:
A summary of the Jungle Book story

Raised by a wolf pack, Mowgli grows up learning the wisdom of the jungle from Baloo the bear and courage from Bagheera the black panther. Joining forces with his friends, he overcomes the threat of the fearsome tiger Shere Khan and learns how to live together in harmony with nature.

content.alt: The Jungle Book - The moral of The Jungle Book
content.text:
The moral of The Jungle Book

The heart of it is that beings who are different from one another can become family through friendship, and the wisdom of living together in nature is precious. Talk with your child about, "How can I get along well with a friend who is different from me?"

content.alt: The Jungle Book - How to read it aloud to your child
content.text:
How to read it aloud to your child

Give Baloo the bear a deep, easygoing voice, Bagheera a calm and graceful one, and Shere Khan a threatening one. Make animal sounds together, and open a conversation with, "What do you need to survive in the jungle?" Best suited for ages 5–7.

content.text:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q. What age is The Jungle Book good for?
A. It's best suited for ages 5–7. Blending adventure with animal friendship, it's loved by a wide range of children.

Q. Who are Mowgli's friends?
A. Baloo the bear, Bagheera the black panther, the wolf pack, and more. Shere Khan the tiger is the threatening figure.

Q. What activities go well with it?
A. Playing animal charades, drawing the jungle, and talking about "becoming friends with someone different from me" all work well.

Classic fairy tales to read together

If you enjoyed this story, try reading these classic fairy tales too.
